notes: This mapping points to the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 named joinFederationExecution API clause and overload declaration. The scenario retries with an adapter-derived distinct name after the duplicate-name exception; it does not assert exception precedence among unrelated join failures.

requirements.statement: The API declares FederateNameAlreadyInUse for the named join overload. After one member joins with a name, the test requires a second connected federate using that same name to receive FederateNameAlreadyInUse.
After the duplicate-name failure, the same connected federate joins successfully with a distinct name and obtains a FederateHandle distinct from the existing member.
